mapper.select: SELECT vwc.dict_platform, vwc.type FROM "virtual_warehouse_channel" vwc inner join virtual_warehouse vw on vw.id = vwc.virtual_warehouse_id and vw.is_deleted = false and vw.disabled = false where vwc.is_deleted = false group by vwc.dict_platform, vwc.type

SELECT vwc.dict_platform, vwc.type,vwc.virtual_warehouse_id,vw.name as virtualWarehouseName,vwc.relation_id,vwc.virtual_warehouse_id,vmcpr.partition_id FROM virtual_warehouse_channel vwc inner join virtual_warehouse vw on vw.id = vwc.virtual_warehouse_id and vw.is_deleted = false and vw.disabled = false left join virtual_warehouse_channel_partition_ref vmcpr on vmcpr.main_id = vwc.id and vmcpr.is_deleted = false where vwc.is_deleted = false order by vwc.dict_platform

SELECT vwc.relation_id FROM "virtual_warehouse_channel" vwc inner join virtual_warehouse vw on vw.id = vwc.virtual_warehouse_id and vw.is_deleted = false and vw.disabled = false where vwc.is_deleted = false and vwc.type = 'shop' and vwc.dict_platform = #{dictPlatform} -- group by vwc.dict_platform,vwc.relation_id

vwc.is_deleted = false and vw.disabled = false

and (vwcpr.partition_id is null or vwcpr.partition_id = '')

select
from virtual_warehouse_channel vwc inner join virtual_warehouse vw on vwc.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse_channel_partition_ref vwcpr on vwcpr.main_id = vwc.id and vwcpr.is_deleted = false
vwc.is_deleted = false and vw.disabled = false and vwc.dict_platform in

SELECT DISTINCT vw.id AS virtualWarehouseId, vw.name AS virtualWarehouseName, w.id AS warehouseId, w.name AS warehouseName FROM virtual_warehouse_relation vwr_self INNER JOIN virtual_warehouse_relation vwr_other ON vwr_self.warehouse_id = vwr_other.warehouse_id AND vwr_other.virtual_warehouse_id != #{virtualWarehouseId} AND vwr_other.is_deleted = false INNER JOIN virtual_warehouse_channel vwc ON vwc.virtual_warehouse_id = vwr_other.virtual_warehouse_id AND vwc.dict_platform = #{b2bForeignPlatform} AND vwc.is_deleted = false INNER JOIN virtual_warehouse vw ON vw.id = vwr_other.virtual_warehouse_id AND vw.is_deleted = false INNER JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = vwr_self.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = false WHERE vwr_self.virtual_warehouse_id = #{virtualWarehouseId} AND vwr_self.is_deleted = false
